scope.global_scale_shape_policy: No exact shape requirement; F32 and exactly 4 data bytes. Safetensors format still requires shape product one.
scope.semantic_only_dtype_policy: SDK from_safetensors checks exact shape/raw byte length, then reinterprets; intended dtype is an additional audit check.
scope.extra_tensors_policy: Allowed, but each must satisfy safetensors format/offset/byte-length validation.
